module.name: BNK VLANs
module.description: F5SPKVlan CRs for BNK TMM data-plane self IPs. TMM configures these IPs on its raw L2 interfaces (NADs have NO IPAM). On AWS, also registers secondary IPs on ENIs.

required.reason: CNEInstance must be running before VLAN CRs can be applied
NAD self IPs must be created first for VLAN IP alignment

optional.name: namespace
optional.description: Namespace where BNK components are deployed

optional.name: auto_lasthop
optional.description: Auto last-hop setting. Set to AUTO_LASTHOP_ENABLED on AWS/Azure to prevent asymmetric routing.

optional.name: aws_region
optional.description: AWS region for ENI secondary IP registration. Empty disables ENI management.

optional.name: gateway_vips
optional.description: Gateway VIP addresses to register as secondary IPs on the external ENI.

optional.name: internal_subnet_id
optional.description: Internal subnet ID for discovering the internal ENI on the HP node.

key_outputs.name: vlans_ready
key_outputs.description: Flag indicating VLAN CRs have been applied
